correctness.rationale: The explicit eight codewords have disjoint distinct two-adjacent-deletion shadow sets whose 27 members exactly partition all ternary triples. An exhaustive rejection of seven-or-fewer-word coverings enumerates all 243 possible codewords as 27-bit masks; branching on a mandatory uncovered triple is complete, and pruning uses only the provable at-most-four shadow bound. Two independently written replay programs agree: 649 memoized states, no seven-word cover.

value.rationale: The 2015 perfect-burst spectrum work gives ternary length-five constructions at sizes 9, 12 and 15 and its exact even-alphabet family. Determining the first uncovered odd-alphabet minimum is a natural finite boundary of that motivating spectrum: the eight-word perfect partition improves the directly supplied nine-word ternary construction and the exhaustive bound shows optimality. Both packing (unique decoding) and covering must hold, so this is not just a cheap arithmetic or normalization check.
